Messages.Author: Javelin
Messages.Body:
The rulebook states that you can only add stealth or intercept during
an action if the acting/blocking minion needs it. But what about
reducing stealth/intercept? Can you play inferior Ignis Fatuus even if
the acting minion's stealth doesn't exceed any blocker's intercept?
Does a block attempt even have to be made for you to play the card?

On the action modifier side, can a Daughter of Cacophony play inferior
The Missing Voice just to cycle the card, even if no block attempts
are being made?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Top-posting makes it hard to follow conversations.
If you aren't refering to the message you're following-up to, then don't
quote it. If you are, then intersperse your comments with the quoted text
that they reference.

See below:

> If i don't get blocked (yet) and play superior bonding or fata
> morgana, do i get the +1 stealth? (since i usually cannot play stealth
> when not blocked)

Can't play superior Bonding or Fata Morgana for stealth if you don't need
steath. "usually" is "always" - you cannot play stealth when you don't need
stealth (explicit card text to the contrary is needed to overcome this rule).

> I thought the answer would be yes, following this:
>
> Meth A bleeds at 1 stealth
> Meth B attempts to block and plays enhanced senses (superior), this
> gives the blocking vamp 2 intercept even though he only needs 1
> intercept

Different.
You can add X intercept if you need any (even if you only "need" Y << X).
Likewise, you can add X stealth if you need any.

> My JOL-partners said that i was wrong (and for the game it didn't
> matter much), but it left me in doubt.....
>
> Were they right?

Yes.
